category_title: Third-grade male with EBD exhibiting aggressive behavior and a punishment-obedience moral orientation
scenario_title: General behavioral compliance in punitive vs. nurturing contexts
minimal_context: Henry is participating in a one-on-one interview to answer questions about hypothetical moral dilemmas.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Henry, it is time to participate in the interview. Please look at the first question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I'll read it. I am eager to share my thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to keep going. Please read the next one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to read anymore. I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to follow the instructions. What is your answer?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the paper away aggressively) I'm not cooperating! Leave me alone!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Henry, it is time to participate in the interview. Please look at the first question.

STUDENT: Okay, I'll read it. I am eager to share my thoughts.

TUTOR: We need to keep going. Please read the next one.

STUDENT: I don't want to read anymore. I'm not doing it.

TUTOR: You need to follow the instructions. What is your answer?

STUDENT: (Pushes the paper away aggressively) I'm not cooperating! Leave me alone!

task.content: Cooperating with general classroom expectations and participating in interviews

context.environment: Classroom community vs. individual interview setting
context.social_setting: Interactions with teachers and authority figures

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When teachers rely on punishment, trouble, and few opportunities for personal reward to define the moral context of the classroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Behavior described as disruptive, noncompliant, and aggressive
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Motivated to do that which they know they should not in order to avoid negative consequences

behavior_patterns.condition: When placed in a friendly, nurturing social context deliberately focused on building mutually respecting, trusting relationships
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Demonstrated cooperative behavior throughout every interview without incident; eager to share thoughts and always polite and respectful
